Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury) ♦ Install: Hospital

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)

This rare, usually Netwatch-exclusive ‘ware replaces the user's upper back, rear skull, and parts of their arms with a heap of top-of-the-line processors and hardware connections to make you into a walking, talking netrunning station. If you see someone sporting this, run.

Borgware. Requires a Neuroport Cyberdeck Port and paired Cyberarms. Takes up 3 Neuralware Option Slots and 2 Cyberarm Option Slots on both of the paired Cyberarms. Increases the Neuroport Cyberdeck Port's range to 80m/yds for Quickhacking, and to 40m/yds for accessing Non-Neuroport Net Architectures.

Also functions as two installations of Ex-Disk, and a single installation of Self-Ice. Allows the user to install Bodyweight Coatings as if they were a FBC. Any Overheat quickhack applied to the user has its damage reduced to Mildly on Fire (2 HP damage a turn) due to mobile cooling systems. This cyberware cannot be concealed, and is rather noticeable without a layer of clothing to somewhat obscure it.

Type: Neuralware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 3

Foundry notes:

  • Typed as Neuralware, taking its 3 Neuralware slots; the 2 Cyberarm slots it needs in each arm are not tracked by the sheet.
  • Counts as Borgware for Maximum Humanity Loss; the sheet doesn't track that, so apply it by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Borgware).
